name: NBA Stats API
tagline: Official NBA statistics endpoints for box scores, player tracking, and advanced metrics.
description: Unofficially documented but widely used JSON endpoints on stats.nba.com that power the NBA's own stats site. Developers use them for player and team statistics, advanced box scores, shot charts, and player-tracking data. The API is free to call without a formal signup key, but requires browser-like headers and is subject to unofficial rate limiting and ToS constraints.

auth.details: No API key. Requests typically require browser-like headers (User-Agent, Referer, Origin, x-nba-stats-origin, x-nba-stats-token) to avoid blocks; not an official public developer product.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No published free tier or paid plans; publicly callable without key, subject to undocumented throttling and ToS

rate_limits: not published (community reports informal throttling / IP blocks under heavy use)

example.request: curl -s 'https://stats.nba.com/stats/leaguedashplayerstats?Conference=&DateFrom=&DateTo=&Division=&GameSegment=&LastNGames=0&LeagueID=00&Location=&MeasureType=Base&Month=0&OpponentTeamID=0&Outcome=&PORound=0&PaceAdjust=N&PerMode=PerGame&Period=0&PlayerExperience=&PlayerPosition=&PlusMinus=N&Rank=N&Season=2024-25&SeasonSegment=&SeasonType=Regular%20Season&ShotClockRange=&StarterBench=&TeamID=0&VsConference=&VsDivision=' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0' -H 'Referer: https://www.nba.com/' -H 'Origin: https://www.nba.com' -H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'x-nba-stats-origin: stats' -H 'x-nba-stats-token: true'

use_cases: get per-game player stats for an NBA season
fetch a game box score with advanced metrics
pull player tracking and hustle stats
query team standings or league dashboards
get shot chart data for a player
look up player career or season totals by ID
